seo.metaDescription: Meet Linkfields, the South Africa-headquartered technology, engineering and advisory company combining services, proprietary software and reusable delivery IP.

sections.title: About Linkfields
sections.subtitle: An AI-driven technology, engineering and advisory company, headquartered in South Africa and backed by leadership with 20+ years of industry experience.

sections.heading: One strategic partner across *your transformation*
sections.body:
Linkfields is an AI-driven technology, engineering and advisory company headquartered in South Africa. We combine five integrated service portfolios with proprietary software and reusable delivery IP to help enterprises modernise, run, analyse, secure and scale their operations.

We also help organisations design, build, operate and scale Global Capability Centres (GCCs), including through Build–Operate–Transfer (BOT). The 20+ years shown below refers to industry leadership experience, not the age of the company.
sections.mission: We help global organisations grow, adapt, scale, reinvent and transform: modernising their technology, running their core platforms, making use of data and AI, securing what matters and scaling their teams.
sections.vision: To become the preferred partner for creative, customised, integrated and sustainable solutions across technology, data, security and talent that enable businesses to thrive and expand.

sections.heading: South African roots, global delivery
sections.body: Our South African headquarters anchors an international technology, engineering and advisory business. Services, owned software and reusable accelerators are brought together around the enterprise challenge, rather than offered as disconnected engagements.
sections.secondaryBody: Digital Transformation; Intelligent Enterprise Platforms; Data & AI; Cyber Security; Talent Advisory & GCC. [Explore our service portfolios](/services) or see [how we deliver](/company/our-approach).

sections.heading: Values *in practice*

items.title: Innovation
items.description: Explore alternatives and test assumptions before committing to a solution.

items.title: Courage
items.description: Raise difficult questions and make risks visible before they become delivery issues.

items.title: Respect
items.description: Listen, challenge constructively and treat people fairly.

items.title: Impact
items.description: Keep agreed business outcomes in view when prioritising work.

items.title: Passion
items.description: Bring care and curiosity to the work, and learn from review and feedback.

items.title: Ownership
items.description: Take responsibility for decisions, actions and agreed outcomes.

sections.description: Our values guide decisions, collaboration and the way we approach delivery.

sections.heading: Global reach, *local accountability*
sections.description: South Africa is our headquarters and India is our Offshore Delivery Centre. Market presence in the UAE, United Kingdom, USA and Australia connects our delivery capabilities with enterprise clients across regions. The map shows our country-level footprint, not office addresses.
sections.strip: South Africa HQ | Global Engineering & Delivery | International Market Presence

items.title: Services depth
items.description: Five portfolios connect engineering, enterprise platforms, data, security and talent around one challenge.

items.title: Software we own and can demonstrate
items.description: Linkworks, testoriumz, VajraX, VectorX and our AI products complement our services.

items.title: Reusable accelerators
items.description: Modernisation, migration, testing and Cyber-Safe Delivery IP provide a starting point that is tailored to the engagement.

items.title: Integrated delivery
items.description: Services, software, managed delivery, dedicated teams and capability centres can share an agreed governance model.

sections.heading: Responsibility beyond delivery
sections.body: We recognise that our organisation has an impact on people and society as well as on client operations. Respect, ownership and meaningful opportunities are part of how we think about that responsibility.
sections.secondaryBody: Our employer story includes the Youth Employment Service (YES) initiative and its focus on meaningful work experience for unemployed young people. Read about this on our [Careers page](/careers#employer-story).
